BAR_TIMEFRAME_USED_FOR_EXECUTION: M1 OHLC; original sealed score-row chronology, including gaps
ENTRY_PRICE_RULE: Frozen accepted entry row OPEN; API time equals actual UTC (offset 0)
STOP_HIT_RULE: LOW <= active stop; entry bar included
GAP_RULE: Exact inherited S5 barrier fill, even across gaps; no extra gap slippage. This limitation applies equally to all candidates and cannot establish live execution realism.
TIME_STOP_PRICE_RULE: First available OPEN at elapsed wall-clock minutes >= horizon, before intrabar exits
BREAK_EVEN_TRIGGER_RULE: Completed surviving bar HIGH reaches trigger; stop at entry active next available bar; no same-bar favorable activation
TRAIL_TRIGGER_RULE: Completed surviving bar maximum HIGH reaches trigger; ratchet stop active next available bar; never loosen
MFE_MAE_SOURCE: Completed surviving M1 bars only; exclude ambiguous exit-bar extremes; timeout includes OPEN only. Units original risk denominator.
TRANSACTION_COST_RULE: Original effective entry spread (observed positive else 30) + 5 points; point=.01; combined extra cost covers existing fees/slippage, no separate added commission
STRESS_COST_RULE: Same frozen spread + 10 points, same original denominator and fills
R_UNIT: Original entry SL price distance for levels; net R denominator ORIGINAL SL distance + entry spread*.01 for ALL candidates; no position resizing
PARTIAL_EXIT_REASON: Existing ledger is full-fill only; no split-fill approximation
ENTRY_ACCEPTANCE: All787 accepted entries immutable; verify candidate single-position, cooldown and daily guard compatibility before each entry; first conflict fails whole candidate without skipping
FOLD_MEAN_R_JUSTIFICATION: Worst baseline fold -0.07300304884173818; fixed floor -0.15 is about twice the historical loss, frozen before new outcomes
HISTORICAL_INTERPRETATION: Paired conditional exit-economics research on previously inspected development entries; not untouched evidence or production strategy replay
COOLDOWN_POLICY: Candidate net_r <= 0 sets last_loss; next frozen entry must be >=15 wall-clock minutes after exit; otherwise whole candidate fails REFERENCE_COOLDOWN_CONFLICT
DAILY_LOSS_POLICY: Exact S5 Taipei calendar day realized account PnL <= -current balance*0.05 rejects whole candidate REFERENCE_DAILY_LOSS_CONFLICT
RISK_POLICY: Initial balance 1000; risk .014; last30 account rewards PF<1.15 after18 trades halves risk; post-loss cap120min has max multiplier1.0 (no additional change)
SAME_TIMESTAMP_POLICY: Only previous OPEN exit (timeout/no_progress) precedes same-timestamp entry; intrabar barrier/cohort-end exits do not
